correctness.rationale: All domains, Haar normalizations and boundary conventions are explicit. The exact finite tree transport identity (7) follows by edge flows and independent 1-Lipschitz edge gradients. The signed kernel-row mass Bellman recurrence (9), solved in closed form, yields \(F_s\). At first divergence \(k\), the two branch row differences have independent optimal nested sign assignments attaining \(2F_s\) at each subsequent depth simultaneously. This gives (1); summation by parts yields (2); geometric sums yield (3)-(4). Contractive cylinder expectations and norm-density in the little-Lipschitz quotient establish (6), and bounded tails are equivalent to fixed-step geometric decay. The independent exact rational checker enumerated the complete sign and leaf-pair sets in several small instances; this corroborates and does not replace universal analytical proof.

value.rationale: This is a complete natural infinite-parameter family of sharp operator norms in an important separable Lipschitz function space. It distinguishes the canonical Haar basis from mere existence of monotone ultrametric retraction bases and determines exactly when signed martingale transforms remain bounded. Formula (4) quantifies nontrivial \(\rho^2\) small-scale amplification and a critical divergence as \(\rho\to1\); both are motivated by stability of multiscale Lipschitz coordinates rather than an arbitrary small-dimensional computation.
